text:
incident-bot: PAGER: prod-ingress gateway - spike in 502/504s (auto-detected)
incident-bot: severity: high | affected: ingress-edge cluster (all regions) | metric: 502-rate 12% -> 38% over 3m | paging: on-call (maria)

maria: on it. seeing alerts in the dashboard. digging into edge-proxy metrics now. @ajay can you join triage?
ajay: here. can you paste the dashboard link?
maria: https://dash.internal/redwood/ingress/edge-proxy?s=last_15m - p95 latency on upstream sockets jumped, connection queue growing.

devon: quick heads-up — no deploys in the last 30m from CI. infra autoscaler didn't kick yet.

maria: copying logs filtered for 502s:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:02Z] edge-proxy-8: upstream request failed: connection reset by peer -> 502
[2026-03-15T14:02:03Z] edge-proxy-3: upstream timeout after 10s -> 504
[2026-03-15T14:02:04Z] edge-proxy-7: active connections = 1200 (max 1300), queue_len=480
```

ajay: looks like an upstream service is slowing and causing head-of-line/backpressure. we should reduce fanout and enable circuit breaking on the route. follow the ingress runbook step 2.a.

maria: executing tactical mitigations now: 1) enable per-route circuit-breaker for /api/* 2) reduce max concurrent requests to upstream service from 100 -> 40 3) activate 2x extra edge proxies in region-us-east as hot spares

ops-bot: command accepted: POST /ops/edge/configs/circuit-breaker body={"route":"/api/*","max_conns":40,"embed_policy":"fast-fail"} -> 202 accepted

maria: circuit-breaker toggle succeeded. applying traffic shaping to reduce fanout to problematic upstream: `route_weight --set order-svc=0.2`

devon: scaling edge pool + aux proxies via k8s HPA patch now: `kubectl scale deployment edge-proxy --replicas=18 -n infra`

ajay: can someone run a quick smoke test hitting a few endpoints? I want to confirm 502s drop.
sarah: support reporting elevated error reports from several customers — visible in status page feed. Customer impact estimate: ~8% of requests for some tenants see 502s. I filed a high-priority support ticket for impacted enterprise customers and linked to status incident.
maria: status update: 502 rate decreased from 38% -> 11% within 5m after circuit-breaker + traffic shaping. still above baseline, monitoring.

ajay: i'm seeing the upstream (order-svc) pods with long GC and socket exhaustion. attaching snippet from upstream logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T13:59:51Z] order-svc-2: thread-pool exhausted, waiting for DB connections
[2026-03-15T14:00:10Z] order-svc-1: slow query detected: SELECT ... (runtime 8.2s)
```
devon: paging the order-svc oncall (sre-team) to investigate DB slowdowns. could be an index regression or increased load from a partner.

maria: mitigation plan while upstream recovers: keep circuit-breakers enabled, keep reduced concurrency limits, maintain small routing weight to order-svc and let other redundant services handle majority of traffic; enable 504->retry fallback for idempotent endpoints.

ops-bot: Routing rule patched: `{ "route": "/api/orders/*", "fallback": "cached-response", "max_conns": 30 }` -> applied

sarah: updating Status page: "We are experiencing elevated 502/504 errors impacting API requests. We have applied mitigation to reduce errors and are investigating root cause. Next update in 30 minutes."

ajay: monitoring CPU/memory on edge-proxies: CPU trending down after scale. connection queue length halved. p95 latency improving. correlating metrics to confirm customer impact reduction.

maria: quick customer check — enterprise-omega (account id: 7892) reported persistent 502s earlier. @sarah any comms?
sarah: Support note updated and direct outreach to account owners in progress. OA: provide timeline once RCA done.

devon: update from order-svc oncall: found runaway background job that spiked DB connections; killed job, DB connections dropped, order pods recovered. they've paused partner job and are running a quick patch.

maria: nice. keeping circuit-breakers on for 15m post-recovery to avoid re-fanout. will gradually restore weights.

ajay: after 20m steady state, 502s down to baseline ~1.2%. closing initial triage. recommend follow-up RCA: 1) partner job TTL/quotas 2) make upstream connection pool defensive 3) add circuit-breaker default per-route in edge config 4) consider backpressure telemetry (queue_len alerts)

sarah: raising follow-up ticket: INFRA-1482 (owner: devon) — RCA + remediation plan + customer comms draft.

maria: handoff to postmortem thread: I'll write up timeline and mitigation steps, include commands and dashboards. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigations in place; monitoring for 60m. severity: moderated -> low.

ops-bot: runbook note appended: "Enable circuit-breaker + reduce max_conns when upstream socket queue > 200"

maria: final note — primary cause: upstream background job spike causing DB saturation -> upstream slow -> edge fanout + connection queue exhaustion -> 502/504 spike. Postmortem will include playbook tweaks and alert thresholds.

sarah: closing customer comms loop after RCA. thanks everyone for the quick response. :heart:
